services.name: corporate fishing trips
services.desc: Corporate guided fishing trips on Lake Minnetonka (just minutes west of Minneapolis) with Lake Minnetonka Fishing Guides is the perfect way to entertain your employees and/or clients.Our professional guides have entertained corporate groups from Cargill, Anheuser-Busch Companies, Con Agra Foods, Cub Foods, Target, Pfizer and Northstar Partners just to name a few. Our guide team is not only great with getting our clients on fish, but we also know how to entertain your clients and show them a great day on the water. We provide a great alternative to golf for your next corporate outing! We can also help arrange for a luncheon, dinner, or cocktail hour at one of the boat to restaurants on Lake

blurb: Guests fish for walleye, largemouth bass, smallmouth bass, northern pike, and panfish on fully rigged, tournament equipped boats. The service provides rods, reels, tackle, bait, life jackets, and gas. Guests must bring a current Minnesota fishing license and any personal gear they prefer.
